title: Aging reports list documents of every location, not only yours
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Your organization has at least two locations, location A and location B.
  • You are working at location A (top right).
  • Location B has an open invoice for customer X today.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket with its arrow button.
  4. Find customer X's invoice from location B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • the location B invoice is listed, with location B shown on its line, although you work at location A.

Why this matters: A manager reconciles the whole organization's receivables from any location.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalAccountReceivableCustomerFetcher.php:254-302; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:41-68. V1 code, quoted: `$qb = $this->organizationDecorator->decorateQuery($qb, 'c.organization_id');`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-007) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
